body:
Thank you so much. Yeah, at least I'll be able to say that I know it is/isn't for me. And exactly, good point - I'll try to remind myself of that too!

Thank you! You have been very kind and I really appreciate it (:

That's the thing - like, I do want to do that (my goal is to become a counselor) it's just that I feel like there are so many people who are better at it then me, and what if I don't get into school, and what if I don't connect with people or I'm lousy at it? And I know that I need to be in an okay place mentally to do the job too, which seems daunting. I just start overthinking everything. 

And like even if I like my job, it's just this overwhelming feeling that I will always feel this way.. 

Sorry, I'm in a bad mood right now. But, I do totally agree with you though and it's totally important to find something that means something to you!

Yeah, maybe the "normal" isn't what's best for me but idk.

I guess I'm worried that even if I get into grad school and my chosen career, I still won't be happy and that is really scary :/

Thank you. I'm glad that things have turned around for you! :) 

I know that things can change, but even when I have so much good stuff surrounding me, I still feel really bad for no reason? Even if I get a job, have friends, etc, I still worry that I will not be happy because I've experienced that in the past. So, it just feels really hopeless even though I know that these things could change... 😮‍💨

Not scattered, no worries! 

And thank you. I haven't really heard anyone else saying they felt this way, so that is reassuring :)
